card.name: The word excellent as praise
card.fires_on: The adjective "excellent" used to praise something, usually right after a verb or article such as provides, is, has, or show. It appears in both general web text and clinical text.

modes.label: Excellent before a noun
modes.description: "Excellent" comes after a verb or article and modifies a noun that follows.
modes.example: your yard while providing<< excellent>> sources of nectar and small insects for

modes.label: Excellent as predicate
modes.description: "Excellent" ends the clause and describes how good the subject is.
modes.example: Magellan's prospects for meeting the scheduled launch aboard space shuttle Atlantis are<< excellent>>, according to project manager John Gerphe
